verdict.rationale: Both SCC hosts, www.scc.virginia.gov and the Clerk's Information System at cis.scc.virginia.gov, serve a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) with explicit directives. An agent can therefore learn its permissions before fetching anything, even though the answer is a blanket "Disallow: /". The Virginia Tax robots.txt belongs to a different agency, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: any granular allow rules, sitemap, or agent-specific guidance beyond a blanket disallow, and any first-party documentation of the crawl policy.
